description:
HALOFLUX  | BY Ryder -- Ms MAIKEBAIs CAT
A beat-synced, breathing halo data visualization wallpaper.

Featuring a massive wireframe mesh, rotating data bands, and outer radiating light beams that dynamically rotate and sync to the beat with automatic camera movement. Built with pure native HTML5 Canvas, zero dependencies.

⚙️ Customizable Settings
(Adjustable directly via the wallpaper settings panel)

Visual Presets: Default / Preset A (Dark Background) / Preset B (Bright Lines)
Speed Controls: Beat Speed & Ring Rotation Speed (Default: 0.6 for a soothing, eye-friendly experience; fully adjustable)
Auto-Camera: Toggle On/Off & adjust camera movement intensity
Lighting & Glow: Glow Intensity & Beam Glow
Retro Effects: Scanline Texture (On/Off)
UI Customization: Show/Hide UI Panel (Turn off for a cleaner, halo-only look)
Audio: Background Music (On/Off) & Volume Control
Performance Optimization: Auto-Pause when covered by fullscreen games (pauses both visuals and audio to save system resources)
